title: Reconcile legacy release lifecycle evidence
outOfScope: Do not change product code, tests, workflows, release metadata, tags, provider Releases, or v0.5.58 public assets.
Do not delete any Dependabot branch or PR.
Do not delete a legacy identity until its evidence is preserved and v0.5.58 coverage is verified.

sources.reason: Records the completed public v0.5.58 delivery and future-adopter evidence.
Historical cleanup evidence; the active source was archived by PR #812.
Provider evidence for the stable public Release and its assets.
Tracks the original future-adopter installer failure family.

riskAssessment.reason: Legacy release identities contain blocked/yellow evidence and cannot be discarded until it is preserved and the later public delivery is bound.

reasons: Outcome and human-benefit records are trust surfaces; legacy evidence reconciliation requires strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized full lifecycle closure and cleanup; every deletion remains conditional on preservation and source-bound coverage evidence.

preReviewWarnings: Preserve the exact red/yellow historical artifacts before deleting either associated worktree or branch.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record bounded destructive lifecycle work before archive.

acceptance: The v0.5.56 blocked predecessor and v0.5.57 yellow corrective evidence are preserved in the main archive with their historical status intact.
Evidence proves v0.5.58 is a stable public Release and that its source contains the v0.5.57 canonical release-URL correction and regression coverage.
Only after those proofs are recorded, the v0.5.56 branch is absent and its repository main worktree is restored to synchronized main; the local-plus-origin v0.5.57 worktree/branch are absent.
v0.5.58 tags/assets and the seven Dependabot PR branches remain untouched.
This reconciliation Work Item completes normal archive, PR, merge, and ai-close-work-item cleanup.
guidelines: Preserve historical Outcome status; do not reclassify red or yellow evidence as green.
Fail closed on any missing archive artifact, branch ancestry ambiguity, or release-coverage mismatch.

intent.problem: The current public v0.5.58 delivery supersedes the earlier v0.5.56/v0.5.57 release attempts, but their local worktrees and branches remain. Deleting them now would lose blocked and warning evidence.
constraints: Do not publish another version for cleanup-only work.
Do not change immutable releases or lower any verification gate.
intent.rationale: Future adopters already receive v0.5.58; a source-bound historical disposition gives repository hygiene without hiding the failures that led to it.

rawUserRequest: 清理前确认是否真的不需要了。完成全部工单为止不要停。要确认的，我授权给你，并写入contract。

declaredIntent.summary: Preserve and reconcile superseded release evidence, then remove only the exact legacy identities no longer required for delivery.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare source artifact digests and status fields before deletion.
